evidence: decorative_mascot: In seg2:start–seg2:end Data stands in the 2012 bar with his arms up and does nothing to the bars. In seg3:start through payoff@-0.4 he stands at the left edge holding a pole while the scale tips without him; only the hook and seg1 give him a causal act.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg3:start to payoff@-0.4 is a seesaw scale of 38% (2012) against 27% (2022). It reuses seg2's numbers, and Data stands at the far-left edge holding a pole, covering the '38%' label. The '1.2 million fewer kids / 6 percent drop' narration never gets a picture.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The closing scene repeats the previous beat's low-income comparison as a stock balance machine instead of depicting the beat's own number (1.2 million fewer kids). Data is placed beside the machine, not as its cause, and his anchor overlaps the label.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Draw the 1.2M / 6% beat as its own scene made of the subject, for example a team bench or a line of jerseys emptying, with Data blowing the whistle or pulling jerseys off the hooks so the count drops. Keep every label clear of his body.
